summary: HWH International Inc. filed an 8-K reporting the resignation of Chan Heng Fai as Chairman and CEO effective September 1, 2026; he remains a board member. Liu Ming Hui and Liu Ming Xing, both newly appointed directors, were named Chairman and CEO, respectively. The changes follow a Securities Purchase Agreement under which Smart Dynamics Technology Limited, owned by Liu Ming Hui, purchased 20,000,000 common shares and warrants for 160,000,000 shares for $10,000,000, gaining board control. Liu Ming Xing and Liu Hui are brothers; Liu Chang, Liu Ming Hui's daughter, is on the board. The event is an abrupt leadership transition triggered by a controlling-shareholder transaction.
